newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Sep industrial output down 6.8 pct on yr.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Sep industrial output down 6.8 pct on yr.

text.p: Singapore's total manufacturing output in September fell by 6.8 percent compared to the same month of the previous year after falling 7.2 percent in August, state television said on Sunday.
Quoting the Economic Development Board, state television said cumulative growth for the first nine months was 4.8 percent compared to the same period last year.
It said the electronic products industry, a key export-leading sector for Singapore, fell 7.4 percent, affected by a global downturn.
The only bright spot was petroleum products, rising 14.9 percent with increased demand due to the coming winter season in the northern hemisphere, state television said.
Leading the falls was transport equipment, down 18.9 percent.
Plastic products shrank 13.9 percent and paints and pharmaceuticals dropped 11.4 percent, state television said.
